sources.title: This board's pinned census engine williamson-hkt-v3 (wil_hkt3.c, hkt_solve64.h), run to completion at n=67 in six row-sum groups

notes: No classification at this order is recorded in the literature. The full census run on this board (all 7 row-sum decompositions of 268 in six groups, 14,758,178 canonical first rows, about 2.27e13 row pairs sent to the linear solver, no nullity-capped system) finds no Williamson matrices of order 67. This is a single run of one engine; the count is exact on the board only through the registered replay of the pinned engine.
